commit.message:
feat(ui/ux): admin-only panel gate + modern home rails + sports hub + single-track subtitles + Alexandria font

- Admin: built-in owner allowlist (8462692188 @MAAHMOUDOMAR) + AdminGate on
  every /admin/** page + header pill hidden for non-admins (locked screen)
- Home: streaming-grade redesign — cinematic hero, continue-watching rail
  (server-side session), upcoming matches teaser, newest/top-rated rails,
  live channels rail, active rooms with live-mode badges
- Sports: new matches table (DDL + drizzle), one-time relative-date sample
  seeding, /sports page (day-grouped schedule, league chips, sports channels,
  inline player), admin manager /admin/sports + public/admin APIs
- Player: ONE visible subtitle track (was: all tracks overlaid), language
  picker menu, Arabic auto-pick, dedupe+cap at playback & payload level
- Typography: next/font Alexandria (arabic+latin) + Outfit self-hosted,
  no render-blocking Google CSS; container widened to 1280px, rails CSS,
  events containers unified, bottom nav = رياضة replaces بحث (moved to header)
- Rooms: live-channel room creation surfaced in /rooms UI, mode badges,
  guest guidance copy, GET /api/rooms exposes roomMode
- Tests: smoke asserts new home rails + matches fixtures seeding
